#!/bin/bash
# This script wraps the execution of task.py
# It ensures that any failure in task.py results in an exit code 1.

echo "Starting the execution process..."
./task.py
RET=$?

if [ $RET -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Error detected. Exiting with code 1."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Execution completed successfully."
exit 0
